desc:
🦝 Welcome to Rakoon! 🦝
Can you pull off the ultimate roadside heist? Play as a mischievous raccoon, grab your trusty wagon, and dodge chaotic traffic to score the best loot!

UPDATE:
● CHAPTER 3: STEVE
COMING SOON: WAGON UPGRADE

🛒 HOW TO PLAY:

● Spawn Your Wagon: Start at the edge of the woods and grab your ride.
● Cross the Road: Dodge cars, trucks, and obstacles to reach the loot zones!
● Steal & Load Up: Grab as many items as you can fit into your wagon.
● Cash In: Head to the Trading Post to sell your stash for coins.

✨ FEATURES:
● Furry Wardrobe Shop: Spend your hard-earned coins on epic new rakoons!

👍 Like and Favorite the game for more updates, new skins, and bigger maps!

Inspired by Over the Hedge.
